title: Non-coders: you can now test your trading rules without writing a line of Python
author: RNAlgotrading

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: plain English rules are ambiguous in a quiet way: 'RSI crosses 30' could mean up or down through it, and the AI picks one without telling you. showing the parsed rule back before it runs would catch most of that.

replies.author: RNAlgotrading
replies.body:
Yes, that was just an example prompt. The more clearer the prompt the more accurate the output will be with any AI. Traders and developers will still have to validate the code generated by AI before trusting them. They can tweak it or ask for refinement within the APP itself. AI 
definitely help a lot to achieve things faster..

Thanks 👍🏻.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: the validate step is the one non-coders can't really do though, they can't read the code they're validating. a plain English readback of what the code actually does, entry, exit, which side of the cross, before anything runs, is a check they can do.

comments.author: RNAlgotrading
comments.body:
That's where RNAlgotrading give 100% free support for non coders, Or they can share the code to other developers to fix the issue if any. I would invite traders ( coders and non coders) to test it out and post their real issues. 

Thanks
